gameDescriptionHtml:
Become an automotive sports mechanic in Rally Mechanic Simulator. Challenge your skills to the limit. Manage the garage, dealing with parts and funds. Fix damaged rally cars, tune them and go to rallies. Deal with bad weather and limited time. Conquer all of that and your competition. Become the mechanic of the best rally team out there. See for yourself if you have the skills and mindset needed for the job.

If you want it, you can achieve it – Your goal will be to handle time pressure and to turn a complete wreck into something that will drive and win a special stage. The entire team’s performance during the rally will depend on your decisions, mechanical prowess, time and budget management.

Get your tools ready! – Creativity and the right items and tools will allow you to conquer all obstacles. Always take them all with you. Windshield replacement? Not a problem. Bumper repair? Piece of cake!

Your workshop is your kingdom – Take advantage of your well-stocked workshop with useful tools for fixing cars. With success comes money and with it, you will be able to upgrade both the tools and parts of your cars. Tune your car or even change its appearance to make a stylish impact during the rally.

Forge your career – While fixing and modifying cars will be the main part of your experience, there will be much more to do. Setting up the team, negotiating sponsor deals and other facets of team and career development are some of the features that set Rally Mechanic Simulator apart from other games in the genre.

It’s not just a random car, it’s a rally car – You are dealing with a rally car – a purpose-built machine. Turbos, coilovers, proper tires and performance transmissions will sooner or later be installed in your vehicle. The car has a lot of extra features that you need to keep an eye on. Make it as good as possible and earn fans and money as a part of a champion rally team.

Game Features

  • Realistic rally car models with lots of interaction.
  • Possibility to work on the electronics of your cars.
  • Car damage and cleaning systems.
  • Ability to paint your cars.
  • Equipped field workshop to make repairs.
  • Extensive economic system.
  • Advanced vehicle development system.
  • Realistic graphics.
  • Advanced car appearance personalization system.
  • Timed repair segments.
  • Extensive tuning options.
  • League progression system.
  • Many achievements to unlock.
